subject.title: fix(install): fail closed on missing git tags, never silent-downgrade

question: Should Git installation universally fail when npm exposes a version without an exact immutable Git tag, with release automation required to publish every matching tag?
rationale: This is an intentional availability-versus-release-provenance policy change for existing Git-install users, not only a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Require exact immutable tags
options.body: Keep the fail-closed policy and enforce release automation that publishes a matching Git tag for every npm version.

options.title: Preserve a compatibility fallback
options.body: Retain the current installation availability behavior and introduce an explicit, documented strict mode only if maintainers accept a non-identical source fallback.

recommendation.title: Require exact immutable tags
recommendation.body: Keep the fail-closed policy and enforce release automation that publishes a matching Git tag for every npm version.
